prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: About-page editorial material-study photograph, one landscape image, 1536x1024.
Primary request: A beautiful designer's working table showing the physical transition from printed paper to dimensional signs.
Scene/backdrop: Neutral warm concrete desktop; thoughtfully sparse composition, photographed close from overhead at an oblique angle.
Subject and placement: On the left, tactile vivid orange and ivory printed business cards and a folded brochure, with a designer's anatomically natural hands checking the paper. In the middle right, a freestanding brushed metal dimensional letter S and a matte charcoal dimensional letter A. To the right, an orange translucent acrylic sample, a few black vinyl swatches, and one small scaled orange and charcoal vehicle-graphic paper proof. A straight metal ruler and subtle graphite measurement marks belong naturally on the desk.
Style/medium: Photoreal high-end commercial product photography with crisp true-to-life paper fibers, metal brushing, acrylic translucency, and matte vinyl; refined editorial art direction.
Lighting/mood: Warm directional daylight and realistic soft-edged shadows; considered, tactile, calm.
Color palette: Orange, ivory, charcoal, brushed metal, neutral concrete.
Text: Minimal tiny printed design may use only “SIGN”, “PRINT”, or “MAKE”, avoiding dense unreadable text.
Constraints: Exactly one image, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Physical real-world materials and natural hands. Illustrative material study, not documentary evidence of an actual company's team or facility.
Avoid: Known brands or logos, fake workshop signage, watermarks, UI, diagrams, excessive tools, clutter, plastic-looking surfaces, extra fingers, dense text.
review: Inspected generated image: correct landscape composition, tactile paper and realistic hands on left, dimensional S/A centrally, orange acrylic and black vinyl samples right, vehicle proof lower right. Text is sparse and legible. Illustrative material study; no claim to show actual SignAds team or facility.
